convert_coco_model_for_init: run the script to convert a COCO pretrained model by removing class-specific heads for pre-training initialization
remove_optimizer_scheduler: run the script to remove optimizer, scheduler, and iteration keys from a PyTorch model checkpoint
remove_class_specific_heads: run the script to remove ROI head box predictor and mask predictor weights from a COCO model
load_and_save_model: run the script to load a PyTorch model checkpoint, strip training artifacts, and save the cleaned model
prepare_model_for_finetuning: run the script to prepare a COCO pretrained model for transfer learning by removing task-specific layers
